name: com.cosgunhalil.tickwise
description: Record and compare deterministic simulations to find desyncs. Tickwise records inputs and per-tick hashes from your own game loop into .rec files, and the tickwise command line tool compares two recordings to name the first tick where they diverge.

samples.description: Eight balls in a box, integer math, recorded every tick. Run it clean, run it with the chaos toggle, and catch the planted bug at tick 421 with tickwise compare.
